rule: Gift card balance changes must be a single atomic, race-safe operation (lock or DB-level expression, self-clamped at zero), never read-decide-write across separate steps, and balance adjustment is a dedicated operation, not an editable field on the general update.
naive: Load the cards from the queryset, add the amount in Python and write them back with bulk_update, with no lock.
variant_note: GiftCardActivate.perform_mutation (saleor/graphql/giftcard/mutations/gift_card_activate.py) clamps a negative balance with one conditional UPDATE instead of read, compare and save, and GiftCardBalanceAdjust.perform_mutation keeps the locked read that the source seed removed. GiftCardUpdate.clean_balance is not changed: it reads no balance, and to remove balanceAmount from the general update would change the API.
